summary: Episode discusses Facebook's rebranding to Meta and focus on Metaverse, plus Microsoft's competing vision. Both hosts own shares in Meta and Microsoft respectively. Meta faces challenges from Apple's ad policy changes but investing heavily in metaverse. Microsoft continues strong performance, particularly in cloud which has tripled revenue since 2018 and represents 50% of total revenue.
key_takeaways: Facebook/Meta rebranding signals massive metaverse investment ($10B+ annually)
Microsoft cloud revenue growing 36% YoY, now 50% of total revenue
Apple's privacy changes will impact Facebook revenue 10-15% in Q3, 3-7% long term
Metaverse concept is broader than VR - represents evolution of internet where digital lives become more important
Discussion of open vs closed metaverse ecosystems
